name: agent-fleet-kit
description: A fleet of Claude agents that builds an app with minimal human oversight: plan, build in parallel worktrees, gate, review, merge, changelog.

scripts.test: node test/unit.js && for s in gatefail lintfix reviewfail reviewstuck dbpush escalate blocked default questions; do test/e2e.sh $s > /dev/null || { echo "e2e $s failed"; exit 1; }; echo "e2e $s ok"; done && FAKE_DB_PUSH_FAIL=1 test/e2e.sh dbpush > /dev/null && echo "e2e dbpush (push fails) ok"
